description: Help of the api_key setting: the TypeSafe key Jev is called with
other: TypeSafe API key Jev is called with

description: Help of the model setting
other: Jev model asked

description: Help of the endpoint setting: the https URL of the System One API
other: https URL of the System One API

description: Help of the keep_threshold setting
other: probability from 0 to 1 at or above which Jev keeps a call or its result

description: Help of the preserve_recent setting
other: number of newest messages whose tool calls are never pruned

description: Help of the truncate_head setting
other: characters kept at the head of a result Jev prunes

description: Help of the truncate_tail setting
other: characters kept at the tail of a result Jev prunes

description: Help of the min_reduction setting
other: share of the history from 0 to 1 the stage must remove to stop the compaction stack

description: Help of the max_state_tokens setting
other: token budget of the history sent to Jev

description: Help of the max_request_tokens setting
other: token budget of one Jev request, history and questions together

description: Help of the timeout setting
other: timeout of one Jev request, as a Go duration

description: Help of the max_parallel setting
other: number of Jev requests sent at once, at least 1

description: Help of the on_short setting
other: keep leaves a short reduction to the next stage, done stops the stack there, revert leaves the history as it was when the reduction is short

description: Help of the reduction_unit setting: the unit min_reduction is measured in
other: unit min_reduction is measured in: characters, or tokens estimated without a tokenizer

description: Help of the dry_run setting
other: true computes what Jev would prune and changes nothing

description: Help of the rules setting: per-tool actions, as motif[,motif]:action[,action] rules separated by semicolons
other: per-tool rules as motif[,motif]:action[,action] separated by semicolons, first match wins, actions keep, prune, truncate, threshold=, call_threshold=, result_threshold=, head=, tail=

description: Help of the pin_inputs setting: substrings of a tool input whose calls are always kept
other: comma-separated substrings: a tool call whose input contains one is always kept, without asking Jev

description: Help of the keep_errors setting
other: true keeps the result of a failed tool call, so it is never pruned away with its call

description: Help of the include_empty_results setting: whether tool calls with an empty result are judged by Jev too
other: true also judges tool calls whose result is empty, which can include calls still running

description: Help of the incremental setting: whether the calls Jev kept in an earlier compaction of the session are asked about again
other: true does not ask Jev again about the calls it kept in an earlier compaction of the session, until their content or the goal changes

description: Help of the min_result_chars setting
other: results shorter than this many characters are always kept, without asking Jev

description: Help of the keep_call_threshold setting
other: probability from 0 to 1 at or above which Jev keeps a call, defaults to keep_threshold

description: Help of the keep_result_threshold setting
other: probability from 0 to 1 at or above which Jev keeps the full result of a call, defaults to keep_threshold

description: Help of the max_pruned setting
other: maximum number of tool calls one compaction edits, pruned or truncated, 0 for no limit

description: Help of the max_removed_share setting
other: maximum share from 0 to 1 of the history one compaction may remove, 1 for no limit

description: Help of the state_input_runes setting: the three input cut levels of the state, full, short and line
other: three levels of cut for tool inputs in the state Jev reads, in characters, longest first: full, short, line, separated by commas

description: Help of the state_text_head setting
other: characters kept at the head of a long text of the state when it is abridged, 0 for none

description: Help of the state_text_tail setting
other: characters kept at the tail of a long text of the state when it is abridged, 0 for none

description: Help of the state_context setting: the context text Jev reads, replacing the built-in one when set
other: context text Jev reads, replacing the built-in one when set

description: Help of the state_stages setting: the ordered list of the state reduction stages allowed
other: ordered list of the state reduction stages allowed, among abridge_texts, collapse_messages, compact_calls, leave_out, merge_calls

description: Help of the goal_source setting: where the goal Jev reads comes from
other: where the goal Jev reads comes from: auto takes the instruction then the last user prompts, prompts always the last user prompts, fixed always goal_text

description: Help of the goal_text setting: the fixed goal Jev reads, required when goal_source is fixed
other: goal Jev reads when goal_source is fixed, required then

description: Help of the goal_prompts setting: how many of the last user prompts make the goal
other: number of the last user prompts that make the goal, at least 1

description: Help of the goal_prompt_runes setting: characters kept of each user prompt in the goal
other: characters kept of each user prompt in the goal, at least 1

description: Help of the preserve_first setting: whether the first message of the history is never pruned or abridged
other: true keeps the first message of the history, the initial request, never pruned or abridged

description: Help of the preserve_recent_tokens setting: token budget of the newest messages that are never pruned, 0 for none
other: token budget of the newest messages whose tool calls are never pruned, 0 for none

description: Help of the preserve_turns setting: number of the last user messages after which everything is never pruned, 0 for none
other: everything after the Nth last user message is never pruned, 0 for none

description: Help of the max_requests setting: the most requests sent to Jev for one compaction, retries included, 0 for no cap
other: most requests sent to Jev for one compaction, retries included, 0 for no cap

description: Help of the max_sent_tokens setting: the most tokens sent to Jev for one compaction, retries included and estimated, 0 for no cap
other: most tokens sent to Jev for one compaction, retries included and estimated, 0 for no cap

description: Help of the decision_log setting: the JSONL file where each decision on a tool call is appended, empty for none
other: JSONL file where each decision on a tool call is appended, created with mode 0600, empty for none

description: Help of the replay_dir setting: the directory where each compaction writes a JSON snapshot to replay, empty for none
other: directory where each compaction writes a JSON snapshot for replay, created with mode 0700, empty for none

description: Help of the retries setting: how many times a request to Jev is sent again on a 429 or a 5xx answer, 0 for none
other: times a Jev request is sent again after a 429 or a 5xx answer, at most 10, 0 for none

description: Help of the retry_backoff setting: the first wait before a retry, as a Go duration, doubled at each retry
other: first wait before a Jev request is sent again, as a Go duration, doubled at each retry, capped at 30s

description: Appended to the note when the spend cap stopped the requests to Jev: Requests and Tokens are what was sent, the calls not judged stay in the history
other: spend cap reached after {{.Requests}} requests and about {{.Tokens}} tokens sent to Jev, the calls not judged stay in the history

description: Appended to the note when calls were kept from the incremental cache without asking Jev: Hits is how many
one: {{.Count}} call kept from the cache, not asked again.
other: {{.Count}} calls kept from the cache, not asked again.

description: Appended to the note when the reduction is estimated: the history could not be read after the prune, so the planned share is reported instead of the measured one
other: The reduction is an estimate, the history could not be read again after the prune, so the planned share is reported

description: Appended to the note with the state Jev was given: Tokens is its size in tokens, Stage the fitting stage that made it fit
other: State read by Jev: {{.Tokens}} tokens, fitted by {{.Stage}}.

description: The Jev stage failed for Reason, pruned nothing and lets the next stage of the stack compact
other: Jev pruned nothing, the next stage compacts: {{.Reason}}

description: The Jev stage did nothing because the backend of the session cannot edit its history
other: Jev skipped: the backend of this session cannot edit its history

description: The Jev stage found no tool call to prune
other: Jev found no tool call to prune

other: Jev reviewed {{.Count}} tool calls: {{.Kept}} kept, {{.Truncated}} truncated, {{.Pruned}} removed, the history is {{.Percent}}% smaller

other: Jev reviewed {{.Count}} tool calls: {{.Kept}} kept, {{.Truncated}} truncated, {{.Pruned}} removed, the history is {{.Percent}}% smaller, short of the {{.Target}}% aimed for, so the next stage runs

description: The Jev stage reviewed Count tool calls and removed Percent percent of the history, below its Target percent, and on_short=done stops the stack here
one: Jev reviewed {{.Count}} tool call: {{.Kept}} kept, {{.Truncated}} truncated, {{.Pruned}} removed, the history is {{.Percent}}% smaller, short of the {{.Target}}% aimed for, so the stack stops here
other: Jev reviewed {{.Count}} tool calls: {{.Kept}} kept, {{.Truncated}} truncated, {{.Pruned}} removed, the history is {{.Percent}}% smaller, short of the {{.Target}}% aimed for, so the stack stops here

description: The Jev stage found the reduction of its plan short of the target, and on_short=revert leaves the history as it was for the next stage
other: Jev would remove {{.Percent}}% of the history, short of the {{.Target}}% aimed for, so the history is left as it was and the next stage compacts it

description: The Jev stage found that pruning every candidate could not reach the target, so Jev was not asked and on_short=revert leaves the history as it was
other: Even pruning every candidate would remove at most {{.Percent}}% of the history, short of the {{.Target}}% aimed for, so Jev was not asked and the history is left as it was

description: The Jev stage would prune Count tool calls, but dry_run is set so nothing changed
one: Jev would prune {{.Count}} tool call, dry run: the history is unchanged
other: Jev would prune {{.Count}} tool calls, dry run: the history is unchanged
